# Operational Notes

This source assigns the transport migration checklist to the platform team and
public HTTP compatibility testing to client teams. It expressly does not define
file-upload size limits or retention policies.

## Important assertions

- The platform team owns the transport migration checklist ([Transport claim](../topics/transport.md#claim-transport-rollout-owner)); heading "Rollout ownership", lines 5-8.
